extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the exact SMBJ5339B row was selected from the SMBJ5333B through SMBJ5388B electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The supplied PDF identity was verified as LCSC C19077494, MPN SMBJ5339B, manufacturer hongjiacheng, with SHA-256 64aade9d6c8bcc630328e7b0e3a958d2e8a83c0e2e2b23ab0c7cb96acffbf112.
Zener reverse semantics are preserved: nominal VZ = 5.6 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 220 mA; maximum ZZT = 1.0 ohm is at IZT and maximum ZZK = 400 ohm is at IZK = 1.0 mA.

The SMBJ5339B electrical-characteristics row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 1.0 microA at VR = 2.0 V, maximum DC zener current IZM = 856 mA, maximum surge current IZSM = 13.4 A, and maximum voltage regulation of 0.25 V, with TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. These additional fields are not represented by the strict schema.

The p. 4 plots are power-temperature derating, temperature coefficient versus zener voltage, thermal resistance versus lead length, maximum surge power, and thermal response. No target-specific zener I-V or capacitance-versus-reverse-voltage plot is provided, and no component-specific capacitance or reverse-recovery time is published.

Maximum ratings include PD = 5000 mW at Tc = 75 degC and forward voltage VF = 1.2 V at IF = 200 mA on p. 1; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 90 degC/W.
omission_reason: No target-specific usable electrical curve was extracted: the datasheet's p. 4 plots cover thermal, surge-power, derating, and temperature-coefficient characteristics, not zener I-V or capacitance versus reverse voltage. Capacitance and reverse-recovery time are not published.
